title: 低温液体与干冰的危害
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/136_低温液体与干冰的危害.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/136_低温液体与干冰的危害/src.py

points.K1: 低温液体：极冷，一离开就沸腾
points.K2: 冻伤：不碰液体和结霜表面
points.K3: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气
points.K4: 压力升高：绝不装进密闭容器
points.K6: 富氧：凝出液氧，远离油脂热源
points.K9: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
points.K10: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在冒白雾的液氮罐和一盒干冰旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a liquid nitrogen dewar giving off white mist and a box of dry ice, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：低温液体与干冰的危害。
overlay: 低温液体与干冰的危害

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指着三个图标：雪花、肺、爆裂的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three icons, a snowflake, a pair of lungs and a burst bottle.
shots.narration: 冻伤、窒息、爆裂，一样都不能小看。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着自己的保温杯走向液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks toward a liquid nitrogen dewar holding his own screw top drinking flask.
shots.narration: 阿杰想用保温杯装点液氮带走玩。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰把干冰块塞进塑料水瓶，正要拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes dry ice pellets into a plastic water bottle and starts to screw the cap on.
shots.narration: 他还把干冰塞进塑料瓶，要拧紧盖子。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研一把按住瓶子，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts her hand on the bottle and shakes her head firmly.
shots.narration: 小研：快放下！密封会炸，还会缺氧！

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师走过来，指向墙上的氧含量报警器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over and points to an oxygen monitor on the wall of the room.
shots.narration: 王老师：先把低温的危险弄清楚。

shots.section_title: 低温液体：极冷，一离开就沸腾
shots.scene: 液氮、液氩、液氧三个低温容器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three insulated cryogenic containers in a row, each with a blank label and a snowflake icon. No text.
shots.narration: 液氮、液氩、液氧，都是低温液体。
overlay: 低温液体：极冷，一离开就沸腾

shots.section_title: 低温液体：极冷，一离开就沸腾
shots.scene: 气体被冷却变成液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gas molecules in a cloud being cooled by a snowflake arrow and collecting as a liquid in a flask. No text.
shots.narration: 它们常温下本是气体，被冷成了液体。

shots.section_title: 低温液体：极冷，一离开就沸腾
shots.scene: 温度计指到极低处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thermometer with the column dropping to the very bottom, frost on the glass. No text.
shots.narration: 液氮约零下196摄氏度，极冷。

shots.section_title: 低温液体：极冷，一离开就沸腾
shots.scene: 液体倒出后剧烈沸腾冒白雾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small open cup of cryogenic liquid boiling violently at room temperature with thick white fog. No text.
shots.narration: 一离开低温环境，就剧烈沸腾。

shots.section_title: 低温液体：极冷，一离开就沸腾
shots.scene: 四个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a frozen hand, lungs with a falling oxygen arrow, a bulging container and a flame. No text.
shots.narration: 四大危险：冻伤、窒息、超压、助燃。

shots.section_title: 低温液体：极冷，一离开就沸腾
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，旁边是一本手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up next to a closed safety handbook.
shots.narration: 熟悉它、小心它，是最好的防护。

shots.section_title: 冻伤：不碰液体和结霜表面
shots.scene: 液滴落在手背上，皮肤发白
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cryogenic droplet landing on the back of a hand, the skin turning white with a frost icon. No text.
shots.narration: 碰到皮肤，会冷灼伤，甚至冻伤。
overlay: 冻伤：不碰液体和结霜表面

shots.section_title: 冻伤：不碰液体和结霜表面
shots.scene: 液体浸湿手套和衣袖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cryogenic liquid soaking into a tight glove and a cuff, the cold spreading inside. No text.
shots.narration: 浸湿手套、衣物，伤得更深更久。

shots.section_title: 冻伤：不碰液体和结霜表面
shots.scene: 徒手摸结霜的管道打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare hand reaching for a frosted pipe and valve, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 结霜的管道、阀门，不能徒手摸。

shots.section_title: 冻伤：不碰液体和结霜表面
shots.scene: 皮肤粘在冰冷金属上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fingertip stuck to a frosted metal surface, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 冰冷的金属，会把皮肤牢牢粘住。

shots.section_title: 冻伤：不碰液体和结霜表面
shots.scene: 液滴飞向眼睛，护目镜挡住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: splashing droplets flying toward an eye, blocked by goggles with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，可能造成永久损伤。

shots.section_title: 冻伤：不碰液体和结霜表面
shots.scene: 冻伤部位不揉搓、不烤火，去医院
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: rubbing a frozen hand and holding it to a heater, both crossed out, then a clinic icon with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 冻伤别揉搓、别烤火，及时就医。

shots.section_title: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气
shots.scene: 一小杯液体变成一大团气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small cup of liquid nitrogen turning into a huge gas cloud that fills a room. No text.
shots.narration: 一升液氮，能变成几百升氮气。
overlay: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气

shots.section_title: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气
shots.scene: 氮气把房间里的空气挤出门外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an invisible gas pushing normal air out of a small room through the door, an oxygen icon fading. No text.
shots.narration: 氮气无色无味，悄悄挤走氧气。

shots.section_title: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气
shots.scene: 小房间、电梯、汽车三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a small closed room, a lift car and a car interior, each with a dewar inside. No text.
shots.narration: 小房间、电梯、汽车里最危险。

shots.section_title: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气
shots.scene: 人突然晕倒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person collapsing suddenly beside a dewar, a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 缺氧没有预兆，人会突然倒下。

shots.section_title: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气
shots.scene: 液氮间有排风扇和氧含量报警器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a liquid nitrogen room with an exhaust fan and a wall mounted oxygen monitor with a green light. No text.
shots.narration: 使用存放场所要通风，装氧含量报警。

shots.section_title: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气
shots.scene: 小研进门前看报警器指示灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pauses at the door and looks at the green light on the oxygen monitor before entering.
shots.narration: 进门前，先看报警器是否正常。

shots.section_title: 窒息：体积膨胀数百倍，挤走氧气
shots.scene: 液氮罐放在密闭小间、冷库里打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dewar inside a closed storage closet and inside a cold room, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不在密闭小间、冷库里存放液氮。

shots.section_title: 压力升高：绝不装进密闭容器
shots.scene: 密闭容器里气体越来越多，压力表上升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed container filling with gas from boiling liquid, a pressure gauge needle rising. No text.
shots.narration: 液体不断汽化，一密闭就憋压。
overlay: 压力升高：绝不装进密闭容器

shots.section_title: 压力升高：绝不装进密闭容器
shots.scene: 保温杯、塑料瓶、螺口瓶装液氮打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a drinking flask, a plastic bottle and a screw cap jar filled with liquid nitrogen, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 保温杯、塑料瓶、螺口瓶，都不能装。

shots.section_title: 压力升高：绝不装进密闭容器
shots.scene: 密封容器胀裂，碎片飞出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed bottle bursting with fragments flying outward, a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 密封容器会胀裂，碎片伤人。

shots.section_title: 压力升高：绝不装进密闭容器
shots.scene: 专用液氮容器配透气盖，盖子松放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a proper liquid nitrogen container with a loose vented cap and a small gas arrow escaping. No text.
shots.narration: 只用专用液氮容器，盖子不拧紧。

shots.section_title: 压力升高：绝不装进密闭容器
shots.scene: 罐口被冰堵住，压力憋在里面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: ice blocking the neck of a container, pressure arrows trapped inside. No text.
shots.narration: 罐口结冰堵住，压力也会憋在里面。

shots.section_title: 压力升高：绝不装进密闭容器
shots.scene: 容器鼓胀、异响，人员后退报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bulging container making a hissing sound, people stepping back and a phone icon. No text.
shots.narration: 容器鼓胀异响，人员远离并报告。

shots.section_title: 材料变脆与沸腾飞溅
shots.scene: 橡胶管、塑料件、垫圈结霜后裂开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rubber hose, a plastic part and a gasket frosting over and cracking. No text.
shots.narration: 极低温让橡胶、塑料、垫圈变脆。

shots.section_title: 材料变脆与沸腾飞溅
shots.scene: 垫圈裂开，接头漏气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked gasket in a pipe joint with a gas leak arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 垫圈变脆，接头就可能泄漏。

shots.section_title: 材料变脆与沸腾飞溅
shots.scene: 冷钢件被撞断
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a frosted steel bracket snapping after a light knock, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 冷的钢件，一撞也可能断裂。

shots.section_title: 材料变脆与沸腾飞溅
shots.scene: 耐低温的专用器具和管子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a set of cryogenic rated tools, a cryogenic hose and a metal dipper with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 要用耐低温的专用器具和管子。

shots.section_title: 材料变脆与沸腾飞溅
shots.scene: 液氮倒进温热容器，沸腾飞溅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid nitrogen poured into a warm container boiling up and splashing out. No text.
shots.narration: 倒进温热的容器，会沸腾飞溅。

shots.section_title: 材料变脆与沸腾飞溅
shots.scene: 先倒少量预冷，再慢慢加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two steps, a small amount poured to precool the container, then a slow steady pour. No text.
shots.narration: 先少量预冷，再慢慢加。

shots.section_title: 富氧：凝出液氧，远离油脂热源
shots.scene: 空气中的氧在冷表面凝成淡蓝色液滴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: air flowing over a very cold surface, pale blue droplets condensing on it. No text.
shots.narration: 液氮比液氧还冷，能把氧凝下来。
overlay: 富氧：凝出液氧，远离油脂热源

shots.section_title: 富氧：凝出液氧，远离油脂热源
shots.scene: 敞口容器里积了富氧液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open container of cryogenic liquid slowly collecting an oxygen rich layer, an oxygen icon. No text.
shots.narration: 敞口容器和冷表面，会积富氧液体。

shots.section_title: 富氧：凝出液氧，远离油脂热源
shots.scene: 可燃物遇液氧猛烈燃烧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a piece of combustible material near liquid oxygen bursting into intense flame. No text.
shots.narration: 液氧让可燃物更易着火、爆燃。

shots.section_title: 富氧：凝出液氧，远离油脂热源
shots.scene: 设备沾油脂、灰尘打叉，干净设备打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a valve smeared with grease and dust crossed out, a clean valve with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 设备不能沾油脂、油污和灰尘。

shots.section_title: 富氧：凝出液氧，远离油脂热源
shots.scene: 明火、热源、可燃物远离液氮罐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dewar with an open flame, a hot plate and paper kept far away by arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 远离明火、热源和可燃物。

shots.section_title: 富氧：凝出液氧，远离油脂热源
shots.scene: 液氧阀门严禁沾油
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen valve with a no oil icon. No text.
shots.narration: 液氧容器和阀门，严禁沾油。

shots.section_title: 冷浴与冷阱
shots.scene: 冷浴放在杜瓦瓶里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cold bath inside a wide mouth vacuum insulated flask with a flask clamped in it. No text.
shots.narration: 冷浴要选对容器，一般用杜瓦瓶。

shots.section_title: 冷浴与冷阱
shots.scene: 玻璃杜瓦瓶外有金属护壳或缠胶带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass vacuum flask inside a metal shell, another wrapped with tape, fragments contained. No text.
shots.narration: 玻璃杜瓦要有护壳或缠胶带，防内爆。

shots.section_title: 冷浴与冷阱
shots.scene: 干冰一小块一小块慢慢加进冷浴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small dry ice pieces added one at a time to a bath, gentle bubbles, a big handful crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 干冰冷浴，干冰要少量慢慢加。

shots.section_title: 冷浴与冷阱
shots.scene: 戴面屏和低温手套慢慢倒液氮，在通风处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a face shield and cryogenic gloves pouring slowly near an exhaust vent. No text.
shots.narration: 倒液氮戴面屏和低温手套，慢慢倒。

shots.section_title: 冷浴与冷阱
shots.scene: 冷阱对空气敞开，凝出淡蓝色液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cold trap open to room air with pale blue liquid collecting inside, a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 冷阱对空气敞开，会凝出液氧。

shots.section_title: 冷浴与冷阱
shots.scene: 先抽真空检漏，再加液氮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two steps, a vacuum gauge with a tick, then a dewar raised around the cold trap. No text.
shots.narration: 先抽好真空、确认不漏，再加液氮。

shots.section_title: 冷浴与冷阱
shots.scene: 发现蓝色液体，人后退，拉下柜门报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person stepping back from a fume hood, lowering the sash and calling the safety administrator. No text.
shots.narration: 发现淡蓝色液体，人退开，报告老师。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 小研穿戴好全套低温防护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands ready in goggles, a face shield, cryogenic gloves, a lab coat and closed shoes.
shots.narration: 操作低温液体，全程穿戴防护。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 【实拍】摘下戒指和手表放进盒子（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands removing a ring and a wristwatch and placing them in a small tray.
shots.narration: 先摘掉戒指、手表等金属饰物。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 【实拍】先戴护目镜，再戴面屏（正面中景）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a person putting on safety goggles and then lowering a full face shield over them.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜，再加面屏，护住整张脸。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴上宽松的低温手套，演示能轻松甩脱（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands slipping on loose fitting cryogenic gloves and showing they can be shaken off easily.
shots.narration: 手套要宽松，溅进去能马上甩掉。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 薄橡胶手套接触低温打叉，低温专用手套打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin rubber glove near cryogenic liquid crossed out, a thick cryogenic glove with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 选低温专用手套，薄橡胶手套不行。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 长袖实验服，外加防护围裙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a long sleeve lab coat with a protective apron over it. No text.
shots.narration: 长袖实验服，必要时加防护围裙。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 【实拍】长裤裤腿盖在封闭鞋面上（脚部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: trouser legs hanging over the top of closed leather shoes, not tucked in.
shots.narration: 穿长裤和封闭鞋，裤腿盖住鞋面。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 网面运动鞋、凉鞋打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mesh sports shoe soaking up liquid and a sandal, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 网面鞋、凉鞋，会把液体留在脚上。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 搬运重罐穿防砸安全鞋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in steel toe safety shoes moving a heavy dewar on a trolley. No text.
shots.narration: 搬运重罐，穿防砸安全鞋。

shots.section_title: 低温防护用品
shots.scene: 从超低温冰箱取样，戴隔热手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears insulated gloves to take a rack out of an ultra low temperature freezer.
shots.narration: 取干冰和超低温冰箱物品，戴隔热手套。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
shots.scene: 二氧化碳气瓶和分子图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a carbon dioxide cylinder with a simple molecule icon of one carbon and two oxygen atoms. No text.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳，是最常见的气体之一。
overlay: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
shots.scene: 饮料气泡、冷藏车、温室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a fizzy drink with bubbles, a refrigerated truck and a greenhouse with plants. No text.
shots.narration: 饮料气泡、食品冷藏、温室都用它。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
shots.scene: 医院和水处理厂图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a hospital and a water treatment tank. No text.
shots.narration: 医疗、水处理也离不开它。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
shots.scene: 实验室细胞培养箱连着二氧化碳气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cell culture incubator connected by a line to a secured carbon dioxide cylinder. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室的细胞培养箱也要用它。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
shots.scene: 干冰装箱运送疫苗和样本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an insulated shipping box with dry ice pellets around vaccine vials and sample tubes. No text.
shots.narration: 干冰是固态二氧化碳，用于冷链。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
shots.scene: 二氧化碳沉到地面和地坑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy invisible gas layer sinking to the floor and into a pit, eye and nose icons crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 它比空气重，无色无味，积在低处。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
shots.scene: 人在低处很快倒下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person bending down into a pit and collapsing quickly, a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 浓度高了，人会很快失去意识。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳：用途广，也会窒息
shots.scene: 培养室有排风和二氧化碳报警器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cell culture room with an exhaust fan and a wall gas monitor, a cold room and a basement icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 培养室、冷库、地下室要通风，必要时装报警。

shots.section_title: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运
shots.scene: 干冰块冒白雾，温度计很低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dry ice blocks giving off white fog beside a thermometer reading very low. No text.
shots.narration: 干冰约零下78摄氏度，徒手拿会冻伤。
overlay: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运

shots.section_title: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴防冻手套、护目镜，用夹子把干冰放进保温箱（可用白色模拟块）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands using tongs to place dry ice pellets into an insulated box with a loose lid.
shots.narration: 戴防冻手套、护目镜，用夹子取。

shots.section_title: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运
shots.scene: 保温箱盖子松放，气体从缝隙逸出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an insulated box with a loosely placed lid and gas arrows escaping from the gap. No text.
shots.narration: 用不密封的保温箱，盖子别封死。

shots.section_title: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运
shots.scene: 拧紧的瓶子装干冰胀裂打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tightly capped bottle with dry ice bulging and cracking, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 装进拧紧的瓶子，会胀裂伤人。

shots.section_title: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运
shots.scene: 车内、密闭小屋大量放干冰打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a car interior and a closed small room each filled with dry ice boxes, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不在车内、密闭小屋里大量存放。

shots.section_title: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运
shots.scene: 放干冰的房间开着排风
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a storage room with dry ice boxes, an exhaust fan running and a gas monitor on the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 存放房间要通风，必要时装报警。

shots.section_title: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运
shots.scene: 干冰包装箱上贴第9类危险货物标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shipping box with a class 9 miscellaneous dangerous goods diamond and a blank label for quantity. No text.
shots.narration: 干冰属第9类危险货物，按规定运输。

shots.section_title: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运
shots.scene: 剩余干冰在通风处升华，倒进水槽打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: leftover dry ice in an open box in a ventilated area with a tick, dry ice tipped into a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 剩余干冰在通风处升华，别倒进水槽。

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒：不贸然进入
shots.scene: 门口看见有人倒在液氮间里，阿杰停步
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops at the door of a liquid nitrogen room where a person lies on the floor inside.
shots.narration: 有人晕倒在液氮间，别冲进去。

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒：不贸然进入
shots.scene: 阿杰在门外大声呼救、拨打电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stays outside the door, shouting for help and dialing an emergency number.
shots.narration: 在外面呼救，拨打120，需要时拨119。

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒：不贸然进入
shots.scene: 报告负责人、学院和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow chain from a phone to the lab supervisor, the school office and the security office. No text.
shots.narration: 同时报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 有人晕倒：不贸然进入
shots.scene: 从外面开门开排风，戴空气呼吸器的人员进入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching on an exhaust fan from outside, then the security officer in breathing apparatus entering. No text.
shots.narration: 在外开门开排风，由戴呼吸器的人救援。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 雪花、肺、鼓胀容器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a snowflake, lungs with an oxygen monitor and a bulging container. No text.
shots.narration: 低温液体：防冻伤、防窒息、防超压。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 禁油图标、松盖容器、防护装备
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a no oil symbol, a container with a loose cap and a face shield with gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 不密封、远油脂、穿戴好防护。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 干冰保温箱、排风扇、第9类标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an insulated box with a loose lid, an exhaust fan and a class 9 dangerous goods diamond. No text.
shots.narration: 干冰：不密封、要通风、按规定运。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣推着装在推车上的液氮罐挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a liquid nitrogen dewar on a wheeled trolley and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：杜瓦与低温储罐。
